summary: PDS Biotechnology Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $50 million of common stock via Yorkville Securities and B. Riley Securities. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. There is no fixed price, premium, or board recommendation. The agents receive a 3% commission. No special-situation dynamics; the ATM is a standard capital-raising mechanism. No risk-arb angle.
